# Raluca Kovacs

Raluca Kovacs is the current Deputy of [District 7](https://flow.je/elections/district-7) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). She was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Raluca Kovacs has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/raluca-kovacs#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 7 with 31.3% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/raluca-kovacs/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O4nt5tiEFP8)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Raluca-Kovacs-Deputy-St-Saviour-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=44)

Raluca Kovacs has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 7](https://flow.je/elections/district-7), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/20/reform-jersey-deputy-to-seek-re-election-in-st-saviour/)\]
